name: 08886 · Stewartsville, NJ
findings: ZIP 08886 (Stewartsville) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08886 (Stewartsville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08886 (Stewartsville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08886 (Stewartsville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
